step.name: configureGenericServer
step.title: Generic server configuration
step.description: Configure a generic Liberty server with only the default config dropin files
step.instructions: Submit shell script to execute step

template.inlineTemplate:
echo "****************************************" echo "Adjusting server.env from ${instance-SERVER_INSTALL_DIR}/server.env"
sedstring="s#JAVA_HOME=.*#JAVA_HOME=${instance-JAVA_HOME}#g;" #if(${instance-SERVER_OUTPUT_DIR} && ${instance-SERVER_OUTPUT_DIR} != "") sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*WLP_OUTPUT_DIR=.*#WLP_OUTPUT_DIR=${instance-SERVER_OUTPUT_DIR}#g;" #else sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*WLP_OUTPUT_DIR=.*#WLP_OUTPUT_DIR=${instance-SERVER_USER_DIR}/servers#g;" #end #if(${instance-ENABLE_MTLS_VIA_HTTPS_PORT} && ${instance-ENABLE_MTLS_VIA_HTTPS_PORT} != "") sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*TLS_CLIENT_AUTHENTICATION_SUPPORTED=.*#TLS_CLIENT_AUTHENTICATION_SUPPORTED=${instance-ENABLE_MTLS_VIA_HTTPS_PORT}#g;" #end sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*TLS_KEY_STORE_KEY_RING=.*#TLS_KEY_STORE_KEY_RING=${instance-SERVER_TLS_KEY_STORE_KEY_RING}#g;" sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*TLS_TRUST_STORE_KEY_RING=.*#TLS_TRUST_STORE_KEY_RING=${instance-SERVER_TLS_TRUST_STORE_KEY_RING}#g;" sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*TLS_KEY_STORE_SERVER_CERT=.*#TLS_KEY_STORE_SERVER_CERT=${instance-SERVER_TLS_KEY_STORE_SERVER_CERT}#g;" sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*HTTP_PORT=.*#HTTP_PORT=${instance-SERVER_PORT_NOTLS}#g;" sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*HTTPS_PORT=.*#HTTPS_PORT=${instance-SERVER_PORT_TLS}#g;" sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*SAF_UNAUTHENTICATED_USER_ID=.*#SAF_UNAUTHENTICATED_USER_ID=${instance-WLP_UNAUTHENTICATED_USER}#g;" sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*SAF_PROFILE_PREFIX=.*#SAF_PROFILE_PREFIX=${instance-SAF_PROFILE_PREFIX}#g;" #if(${instance-SERVER_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID} && ${instance-SERVER_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID} != "") sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*EKMF_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID=.*#EKMF_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID=${instance-SERVER_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID}#g;" #end #if(${instance-SERVER_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID_OPENAPI} && ${instance-SERVER_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID_OPENAPI} != "") sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*EKMF_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID_OPENAPI=.*#EKMF_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID_OPENAPI=${instance-SERVER_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID_OPENAPI}#g;" #end sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*OIDC_PROVIDER_TRUST_ALIAS_NAME=.*#OIDC_PROVIDER_TRUST_ALIAS_NAME=${instance-SERVER_OIDC_PROVIDER_CERT}#g;" sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*OIDC_PROVIDER_KEY_ALIAS_NAME=.*#OIDC_PROVIDER_KEY_ALIAS_NAME=${instance-SERVER_OIDC_PROVIDER_CERT}#g;" #if(${instance-SERVER_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET} && ${instance-SERVER_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET} != "") sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*EKMF_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET=.*#EKMF_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET=${instance-SERVER_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET}#g;" #end sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*HOST=.*#HOST=${instance-SERVER_HOSTNAME}#g" sed -e "$sedstring" ${instance-SERVER_INSTALL_DIR}/server.env > ${instance-SERVER_USER_DIR}/servers/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}/server.env; if [ $? -gt 0 ]; then echo "error adjusting server.env" exit "8"; else echo "server.env adjusted and copied to ${instance-SERVER_USER_DIR}/servers/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}/server.env" fi
echo "****************************************" echo "adjusting jvm.options from ${instance-SERVER_INSTALL_DIR}/jvm.options" sedstring="s#-Djava.util.prefs.userRoot=.*#-Djava.util.prefs.userRoot=${instance-SERVER_USER_DIR}/servers/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}/preferences#g;" sed #if(${instance-WLP_ANGEL_NAME} && ${instance-WLP_ANGEL_NAME} != "") sedstring="${sedstring} s#^[ \#]*-Dcom.ibm.ws.zos.core.angelName=.*#-Dcom.ibm.ws.zos.core.angelName=${instance-WLP_ANGEL_NAME}#g;" #end sed -e "$sedstring" ${instance-SERVER_INSTALL_DIR}/jvm.options > ${instance-SERVER_USER_DIR}/servers/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}/jvm.options; if [ $? -gt 0 ]; then echo "error adjusting jvm.options" exit "8"; else echo "jvm.options adjusted and copied to ${instance-SERVER_USER_DIR}/servers/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}/jvm.options" fi
echo "****************************************" echo "Setting up symlinks and folder structure" # Create symlinks to the installation folder cd ${instance-SERVER_USER_DIR}/servers/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME} echo "creating symlink to ${instance-SERVER_INSTALL_DIR}/EkmfWeb.properties" ln -s ${instance-SERVER_INSTALL_DIR}/EkmfWeb.properties EkmfWeb.properties echo "creating symlink to ${instance-SERVER_INSTALL_DIR}/apps" ln -s ${instance-SERVER_INSTALL_DIR}/apps apps
if [ -d "${instance-SERVER_INSTALL_DIR}/includes" ] then echo "creating symlink to ${instance-SERVER_INSTALL_DIR}/includes" ln -s ${instance-SERVER_INSTALL_DIR}/includes includes; fi
echo "creating symlink to ${instance-SERVER_INSTALL_DIR}/resources" ln -s ${instance-SERVER_INSTALL_DIR}/resources resources echo "creating symlink to ${instance-SERVER_INSTALL_DIR}/server.xml" ln -s ${instance-SERVER_INSTALL_DIR}/server.xml server.xml
#if(${instance-SERVER_OUTPUT_DIR} != "" && ${instance-SERVER_OUTPUT_DIR}) echo "Creating a symlink to the ${instance-SERVER_OUTPUT_DIR}/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME} output directory for convenience" ln -s ${instance-SERVER_OUTPUT_DIR}/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME} output #end
if [ -d "${instance-SERVER_INSTALL_DIR}/configDropins" ] then echo "configDropins folder found in ${instance-SERVER_INSTALL_DIR}" echo "creating ${instance-SERVER_USER_DIR}/servers/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}/configDropins" mkdir configDropins echo "creating ${instance-SERVER_USER_DIR}/servers/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}/configDropins/overrides" mkdir configDropins/overrides
echo "creating symlinks to the configDropins subfolders"
echo "creating symlink to ${instance-SERVER_INSTALL_DIR}/configDropins/defaults" ln -s ${instance-SERVER_INSTALL_DIR}/configDropins/defaults configDropins/defaults
echo "creating symlink to ${instance-SERVER_INSTALL_DIR}/configDropins/options" ln -s ${instance-SERVER_INSTALL_DIR}/configDropins/options configDropins/options
echo "Finished setting up configDropins:" ls -al configDropins/ fi echo "Symlinks and folder structure set up" echo "****************************************"
